label: H3C S5130S-10MS-UPWR-EI
description: H3C S5130S-10MS-UPWR-EI: 8x 1G/2.5GBASE-T 802.3bt UPoE (90 W a port), 2x 1G/10G SFP+ uplinks, 370 W PoE budget on AC and 740 W on DC, 80 Gbps port switching capacity, 60 Mpps.

poe.note: 370 W total PoE power on AC (maximum draw 447 W) and 740 W on DC (maximum draw 794.2 W), 90 W maximum a port. The vendor PoE table rates all eight copper ports at 15.4 W, 30 W and 60 W, which a 370 W AC budget cannot hold at 90 W a port - four ports at 90 W is the AC ceiling.

fabric.note: Port switching capacity 80 Gbps (8 x 2.5G + 2 x 10G, full duplex), forwarding capacity 60 Mpps.

notes: S5130S-EI common platform (Comware 7): box switching capacity 336 Gbps, 256 MB flash / 512 MB SDRAM, IRF2 stacking of up to 9 units, static routes plus RIP and OSPF, 802.1Q VLAN, LACP, STP/RSTP/MSTP, DHCP server, SNMPv1/v2c/v3, NETCONF/gRPC, web UI and CLI. Port layout and PoE totals from the vendor hardware-information page (https://www.h3c.com/en/Support/Resource_Center/EN/Switches/Catalog/S5130S/S5130S-EI/Technical_Documents/Product_Literature/Hardware_Information___Specifications/H3C_S5130S-EI_IG/202306/1867335_294551_0.htm); switching and forwarding figures from the vendor product page (https://www.h3c.com/en/Products_and_Solutions/InterConnect/Switches/Products/Campus_Network/Access/S5130/H3C_S5130S_EI/). Current software line is Comware 7 CMW710, release R6381 listed on the H3C resource centre for this series (https://www.h3c.com/en/Support/Resource_Center/EN/Switches/Catalog/S5130S/S5130S-EI/default.htm). Three fans, 300 x 260 x 43.6 mm, <= 3.5 kg, 22.2 W minimum draw. The eight copper ports are 1G/2.5GBASE-T UPoE (the vendor calls the scheme UPoE at 90 W), so this is a multi-gig access box rather than a gigabit one; uplinks are 1G/10G SFP+. Serial console plus micro USB console, 16 Gbps maximum stacking bandwidth.
